title: The hammer: what it breaks vs what it cracks
question: The gnome alternates hammer and pick along a cliff: hammer to break, pick to clear the rubble. Do the fissure stars radiating from each blow read as damage the rock is carrying - the reason to pick the hammer up rather than the pick? And is the amount of visible cracking right, or too much / too little?
context_md: 11 hammer blows landed (241 cells broken) + 53 pick bites over the run; he travels 171 -> 305. Hammering ALONE stalls at 3 blows: a blow does not excavate, so the rock it breaks stays as rubble, the face retreats past hammer_reach, and the pile is a drift he cannot wade through. Alternating the two is the loop the belt exists for, and is what this sheet shows. zoom=3, cropped on the passage.
